title: How preprocessing choices change decoding results
question: How much does cross-validated decoding accuracy on public EEG data move when only the preprocessing pipeline changes (high-pass cutoff, low-pass cutoff, line-noise notch), with the classifier, features, data and seed held fixed?

motivation.claim: All artifact-correction steps reduced decoding performance, while higher high-pass cutoffs increased it.
motivation.source: market/landscape.md §3 (Kessler et al., Commun Biol 2025, doi:10.1038/s42003-025-08464-3)

motivation.claim: 43 pipelines tested; no single best pipeline.
